source_claim: Hasbro identifies Sci-Twi as a special edition My Little Pony Equestria Girls character and explains that this Twilight Sparkle lives in the Equestria Girls world and attends Crystal Prep.
notes: The official Hasbro announcement explicitly names the distinct Sci-Twi character and places her in Equestria Girls. This proposal maps only the exact sci-twi campaign key and does not merge her with pony Twilight Sparkle.
